76878.subject: 👑 Qwen beats Claude and ChatGPT
76878.body:
----------
######                  [Collaborate with us](https://utm.genai.works/r/he2t9cz)


--------------------
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/8776fa6e-e2d0-4aec-9648-1bed6de3a659/GenAI_Daily_Banner.jpg?t=1778687445)
Caption: 


----------

----------
**Welcome back!** Alibaba priced its biggest model at half what OpenAI charges and said the weights go free next week. An OpenAI model nobody can use yet cleared ten math problems that had sat untouched for decades, YouTube spent months deleting slop farms, and Altman took his next model to Washington, meaning a launch is expected soon.

**In today's Generative AI Newsletter:**

* **Alibaba:** What are you getting for free next week?

* **OpenAI:** What did $2,000 of tokens prove?

* **YouTube:** How to survive the purge?

* **Astra:** Who has seen OpenAI's next model?


----------



----------
## Alibaba undercut OpenAI by half

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/2e085b47-edfd-4e1b-8dc1-15da55c85589/Beehiiv_01_-_Aug_3.png?t=1785749438)
Caption: 

Alibaba previewed Qwen3.8-Max two weeks ago with no price and no benchmarks. Today it [went on sale](https://qwen.ai/blog?id=qwen3.8), and the numbers are impressive.

Qwen charges $2 per million input tokens and $6 for output. OpenAI cut Terra to $2 and $12 on Friday, so Qwen launched at half the output price three days later.

The open weights for the full 2.4 trillion parameter model go up next week. 

The smaller Qwen3.8-27B goes open too, which is the one that runs on hardware you can actually buy.

Alibaba's headline claim is a model that codes alone for more than ten days, from an empty folder to something shipped, with the whole project history published on GitHub.

Take the rankings carefully. Alibaba says it sits second only to Fable 5, but this is based on its own internal evals. If it’s actually true we should all reconsider our AI strategy.


----------









----------
## 

### 10x the context. Half the time.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/1bf4405b-3b89-41e6-8066-f91af9b08cee/flow-used-by-1000s-professionals.png?t=1776897913)
Follow image link: (https://ref.wisprflow.ai/beehiiv-ai/?utm_campaign=RQICH3JXNF&utm_source=beehiiv&utm_term=ai_s1_q3&_bhiiv=opp_45665eea-dab3-4c6d-9e48-d364f32c325d_4de8c0ec&bhcl_id=f75f7e5c-d39f-4234-8a4e-a4530a9be9e9_35720997-84dc-4283-a2e5-ca9b4b2bb0c3_26702a8b-704e-4ac6-8cf7-0819d5fabd3f)
Caption: 

Speak your prompts into ChatGPT or Claude and get detailed, paste-ready input that actually gives you useful output. Wispr Flow captures what you'd cut when typing. Free on Mac, Windows, and iPhone.
